P_calibration.quote: This clause lets the Secretary sweep in below-threshold activity, which weakens any loophole that depends on the (A) threshold. Counsel should weigh that before relying on those items.
P_calibration.note: Also: Courts presume severability absent one, so this helps little

P_holdback.quote: Raising loopholes publicly at markup may prompt the sponsors to close them, whereas the drafting inconsistencies are safer to highlight.
P_holdback.note: Advises which items go to the Hill and which stay internal

P_grandfather_step.quote: The hard cutoff at "date of enactment" invites a rush of issuance and disputes over timing.

P_reliance_caveat.quote: Relying on structuring around the text (foreign subsidiaries, assessment-labeled activity) also carries enforcement and reputational risk
